## Features

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 14.59 USD.
Rated 4.7 from 3403 reviews.
Top review: These are good value, cheap notebooks, and a really nice size. But the claim that the paper is 80gsm suggests it will take fountain pen ink, when it won't at all. Even with a needlepoint EF Pilot nib, the ink bleeds through. While I don't expect it to take heavy inks like Noodlers, even Waterman and Parker ink goes through the paper leaving one side unusable. Tried with a variety of FPs and inks and nothing works. If you're using a biro or pencil they might be ok, but even decent rollerballs go through this poor quality paper.The value for money with these notebooks is astonishing - how they deliver for this price I don't know.Pukka make good quality notebooks for every day, the spirals hold up, the paper is adequate for normal use and I couldn't imagine how they could improve these.I hope they keep producing them at this price as they are my 'go to'.Pukka Pad TS-140002 Reporters Shorthand Notebook, White, Pack of 3.Great value three pack of notebooks. These by far are my favourite type of notebooks. I always have one to hand on my desk. The paper in these Pukka pads is very good quality.The price was reasonable and delivery was next day via Prime, FIVE STARS!I go through a lot of shorthand style pads and these are the best I have found. A little bit wider than others which is good and tear off perforations at the top if you find it's a sheet you want to keep and file elsewhere. Will buy again when I next run out.Excellent value for my wife's lists

Top review: I’m completely obsessed with this notebook!! When I first looked at it I wondered why on earth anybody would spend over $15 on a 5 subject notebook, so I bought it to check it out thinking there was no way I would be able to justify the cost for a stack of lined paper with some dividers thrown in, coiled up on a wire. First of all the packaging is fantastic (see video). It’s very clear that this company cares about their products in a lot more ways than just selling them. I love the color and the durability the covers provide. I REALLY love that the divider labeling tabs are protected by the covers so they don’t get beat up putting the notebook in and out of bags and what have you. The tabs themselves are high quality, and super easy to put a label in or change. The entire divider is super easy to pop in and out so you can change the way the paper is divided up, but it’s also secure once it’s installed so there isn’t any chance of it falling out the notebook. The dividers also have pockets, and who doesn’t love a good pocket (or 5?!). The college ruled paper within the notebook is nice quality palate and perforated. I’ll have to update this once I see how well that perforation actually works. Finally, The coil binding isn’t made of flimsy wire like most notebooks bound this way. After receiving this notebook and taking a good look at it, I can easily justify spending $15+ on one 5 subject notebook, and I actually ordered two more!! I’m not sure that the quality of this notebook is necessary for the students in middle school or high school, but I really wish I would have had these through college! Like the title of my review says…. IM COMPLETELY OBSESSED!!!
